title: Fast sound effect gen and editing tool I made
author: Goatman117

comments.author: Goatman117
comments.body: Keen for feedback and ideas on this one, let me know your thoughts! [foley-ai.com](https://www.foley-ai.com/?utm_source=reddit)

replies.author: IncorrectAddress
replies.body:
Have you thought about integrating something like this ? (popular with game dev's)

[https://www.bfxr.net/](https://www.bfxr.net/)

It could be that the user could create an FX, and then pass that to AI to improve it, and maybe edit it after, rinse repeat, until they are happy with the results.

I'm not sure how far you can take that, but it's nice to be able to have more control over sounds in the design and development process, a tiny tweak can make all the difference.

replies.author: Goatman117
replies.body:
Hey thanks for sending that, that's a cool tool!

I'd love to integrate something like that, but as far as passing the effect through an AI model to modify  it I'm not aware of any models for this (atm most are just text to audio, to modify you'd need text+audio to audio if that makes sense).

You've got me thinking though, maybe I could setup parameters to tweak the generated effects though? What do you think?

replies.author: IncorrectAddress
replies.body:
Well, If it's just functionality such as "increase bass" or "remove popping" etc... in the user's prompt, then that's already good, because generally it would take someone to use Audio Applications to fine tune a sound, and you would be providing most users with a more rounded tool.

The other option would be to have the AI listen to a sound as "Data" and for it to have an understanding of the "Data" as a sound, tbh, it must have this functionality, otherwise it wouldn't be able to understand what to create from the text prompt.

replies.author: Goatman117
replies.body:
I’ll look into setting up some audio modification tools then for sure!
On the ai front I think I follow what you’re describing. It would probably require finetuning of an open source model like Stable Audio with a dataset that includes text prompts paired with input and output audio; so I’d first need to find/create an appropriate dataset, which is a but of a job..
But a model that allows users to tweak audio based on  text prompts would be so handy; I’d love to chase it up down the line
